title: § 7923.600 determination and segregability records — follow-up to W012663
summary:
Follows W012663-050426 (closed 2026-05-14), which dispositioned audit-log records of NCRIC's onward disclosure of SMPD-originated ALPR data to UOP, Stanford, and USF as either 'no responsive records' (Items 1, 3, 4, 5) or withheld under Gov. Code § 7923.600 (Items 2 and 6). § 7923.600 covers investigations conducted by 'a state or local police agency,' so invoking it for UOP/Stanford/USF audit-log entries carries an implicit position that those private-university campus police are state or local police agencies — directly contrary to UOP's Chief of Police's 2026-03-11 written statement that UOP is not subject to CPRA.

This request asks for the Department's analytical and decisional records supporting the W012663 dispositions:

- Item 1: § 7923.600 determination records (analysis of whether UOP/Stanford/USF qualify as 'state or local police agencies').
- Item 2: segregability analysis records under § 7922.525(b) for the audit-log records withheld.
- Item 3: withholding log identifying record type, volume, and date range for each record withheld.
- Item 4: records of SMPD's position on § 1798.90.55(b) lawfulness of NCRIC's onward disclosures.
- Item 5: records describing the relationship between the Item 1 'no responsive records' finding and the Item 2 § 7923.600 invocation (which presupposes records exist) for the same underlying disclosure event.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Did SMPD perform any threshold analysis that UOP/Stanford/USF campus police qualify as state or local police agencies, given UOP's own contrary written position?

policy_promises.quote: any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection
policy_promises.tests: Did SMPD perform a segregability analysis identifying non-exempt fields (e.g., recipient identifier, date range, channel/volume metadata) in the withheld audit-log records?

policy_promises.quote: ALPR information shall not be sold, shared, or transferred except to another public agency
policy_promises.tests: What records reflect SMPD's position on whether NCRIC's onward disclosure to UOP/Stanford/USF was lawful?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012663 dispositions (Items 1, 3, 4, 5 'no responsive records'; Items 2 and 6 withheld under § 7923.600) are what this request asks the Department to document its reasoning for.
Produced the original Flock event log showing the UOP networkShare lifecycle.
Concurrent Policy 463.8(b) authorization records request for the 2026-02-12 UOP create event.

filed_because: W012663's denial-procedure paragraph asked the Department to address segregability and to identify withheld record type, volume, and the basis for any non-public-agency rationale. The May 14 response addressed the exemption citation only. This request asks for the analytical and decisional records that should underlie any defensible § 7923.600 invocation against records of disclosures to private institutions.
notes:
Closed 2026-05-21. SMPD invoked Gov. Code § 7927.705 (Evidence Code privileges, including attorney-client privilege) for Items 1, 2, and 3, citing Haynie v. Superior Court for the proposition that no privilege log is required. Items 4 and 5 answered 'no responsive records.'

Parser marked 'needs_review' because the request body quotes closure language about the parent W012663 request. Status set manually.

The Item 3 response is notable: by citing privilege rather than describing the underlying records, SMPD declined to confirm even the basic categorical facts about what records were withheld under § 7923.600 in W012663.

The Item 4 'no responsive records' answer is significant: it states that SMPD has no written record of any analysis or communication on whether NCRIC's onward disclosure to UOP, Stanford, or USF was consistent with Civil Code § 1798.90.55(b).
